Who is Chongyue (重岳) to Dusk?

Chongyue is Dusk's elder brother. Her objective record explicitly lists him as 「重岳，留舰人员年、夕、令的兄长」 — i.e. the elder brother of Nian, Dusk, and Ling. Wang (王) is described as a younger brother of Chongyue and an elder brother of Nian/Dusk/Ling — so within the sibling group Chongyue is the eldest.
